answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a trellis seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The thread receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank therefore goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 82 aliases trips the duplicate check at the tundra gate. Slashing removes 81 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
